report.reading_scope: Read the official published full text, sections 1–14, including theorem hypotheses and proof sketches. Checked selected bibliography entries for theorem locations. Consulted arXiv v1 for version identity, not as a substitute for the published text. Read the sign conventions, Theorem 1.3, Lemma 2.2, Lemma 5.2 and Proposition 5.4 in Chodosh's December 5, 2021 Math 258 notes.

proof_scope.2G03: Full normal-variation computation, including metric derivative, normal derivative, Hessian term, curvature contraction and integration by parts.
proof_scope.2G05: Gauss equation derived from the tangential/normal connection decomposition, then doubly traced.
proof_scope.2G06: Gauss–Bonnet is cited; triangulation describes its derivation but is not labelled a complete proof.
proof_scope.2G07: Full deduction from the stability inequality and cited Gauss–Bonnet and surface classification.
proof_scope.2G08: Existence and regularity of the integral homology minimizer are cited; stability of each smooth component is deduced.
proof_scope.2G09: Full contradiction using a retracted nonzero torus class, the cited minimizer theorem, stable-surface topology and the Hurewicz image.
proof_scope.2G0B: Full positive-function quadratic-form identity by expansion and integration by parts.
proof_scope.2G0C: Full deduction using the cited existence of a positive first eigenfunction and the cited conformal scalar-curvature transformation formula.
proof_scope.2G0D: Both the lower bound and sharpness of the hyperbolic spectral bottom are proved; the rescaled counterexample uses a strictly greater than four.
proof_scope.2G0F: Full weighted second-variation computation and the three-dimensional curvature inequality.
proof_scope.2G0G: The sharp torical-band theorem is cited. The displayed cotangent barrier and its potential identity are verified directly; they are not presented as the complete width proof.
proof_scope.2G0K: The three-dimensional identity and the sum over orthonormal pairs are direct contractions.
proof_scope.2G0L: Full deduction of the spectral Ricci inequality from the Gauss equation and stability.
proof_scope.2G0M: Full graph-area Euler–Lagrange computation and equivalence with arbitrary compactly supported normal variations.
proof_scope.2G0N: Full calibration/Stokes proof for comparison surfaces whose difference bounds a compact piecewise-smooth oriented chain in the cylinder.
proof_scope.2G0O: Stable Bernstein is cited with intrinsic dimension at most five; its method is described without claiming a complete proof.
proof_scope.2G0P: Generic regularity in ambient dimension at most eleven is cited, distinguished from unconditional regularity in ambient dimension at most seven.
proof_scope.2G0Q: The spectral diameter theorem is cited; normalization of an arbitrary positive lower bound is calculated.
proof_scope.2G0R: Positive first eigenfunction existence is cited. One-dimensionality of the lowest eigenspace is proved using 2G0B.

deferred: Full geometric-measure-theory construction, compactness and regularity of codimension-one minimizers.
Full proof of Gauss–Bonnet and the elliptic analytic inputs to positive first eigenfunction existence.
Derivation of the conformal scalar-curvature transformation formula.
All-dimensional torus obstruction and its full iterative homological descent.
Theorem 7.2 localization, which needs careful dimensional and regularity assumptions beyond the condensed source statement.
Full mu-bubble existence, barrier regularization and exclusion of equality in the torical-band theorem.
Complete proofs of four- and five-dimensional aspherical obstructions, slice-and-dice decompositions, cover-width bounds and Corollary 9.4.
Section 10 noncompact and positive-mass branches; Section 11 Dirac and surgery comparisons.
Bi-Ricci diameter and spectral Bishop–Gromov theorems and their full proofs.
Complete stable Bernstein and generic-regularity proofs, including tangent cones and quantitative separation estimates.
The unresolved cases are reported as questions posed in the published report, not as independently refreshed claims about the research frontier.

source_errata: The official section 6 displays -Delta_H2 >= -1/4. The useful sharp lower bound is +1/4, independently proved in 2G0D.
The hyperbolic-plane example supplies strict spectral positivity of -a Delta + K only for a > 4. At a = 4 its bottom is zero; no endpoint counterexample is asserted.
The source's instructions to pretend spectral positivity is pointwise positivity are explanatory shortcuts, not mathematical implications. 2G0C inserts the conformal step.
The stable closed-surface genus statement is given with orientability explicit; a two-sided nonorientable surface in a nonorientable ambient manifold requires separate treatment.
Scalar mean curvature uses A(X,Y)=<nabla_X nu,Y> and vector mean curvature uses -H nu. The normalization difference in the existing conformal-surface page is stated.
The hyperbolic page 0C81 uses the opposite Laplace sign; 2G0D explicitly fixes Delta=div grad.
The torical-band bound is strict; the stable Bernstein range is intrinsic dimension <= 5; generic regularity is ambient dimension <= 11.
